improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
improve.coach: 56% of matches overall, down to 40% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: 56% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
improve.coach: Flagged 33% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. There in 56% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You were handing out chances like Halloween candy. 44% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.
